name: Simulation:Green Grass
source:
Where do we go when we want to escape? For Kaimana, it's a meadow where sunlight bathes the lush green grass and a gentle breeze blows through his hair. Here, he always visits the same person to find comfort and peace in his chaotic life.

[From [url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/greengrasssim]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当我们想要逃避时，我们该去哪里？对于凯马纳来说，这是一片草地，阳光沐浴在茂盛的绿草上，微风吹过他的头发。在这里，他总是拜访同一个人，在混乱的生活中寻找安慰与平静。

[来自[url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/greengrasssim]itch.io[/url]]
